標題： 【考試】5/3 多益校園考(正式考試)延長報名至4/2公告
日期： Mon, 31 Mar 2025 17:20:07 +0800

113-2 學期 5 月 3 日多益校園考(正式考試) 延長報名至 4 月 2 日


多益校園考僅提供本校教職員生報名，報名費約1,200元。

校園考提供之成績單樣式及證明文件申請服務與公開考不同，請見連結說明，https://lc.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/77/1077/img/1146/127722122.pdf

The TOEIC Campus Test for the 113-2 Semester (Official Exam on May 3) – Registration Extended Until April 2

The TOEIC Campus Test is available only to NDHU’s faculty, staff, and students. The registration fee is approximately 1,200 TWD.

Please note that the score report format and certificate application services for the campus test differ from those of the public test. For details, please refer to the following link: https://lc.ndhu.edu.tw/var/file/77/1077/img/1146/127722122.pdf
